verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms Pulumi serves an llms.txt at https://www.pulumi.com/llms.txt (HTTP 200) with a structured product summary, so an agent can be pointed at it directly. Pulumi also has an AI-focused docs section that includes MCP-server guidance for agents. Missing for 10: per-page markdown docs (the /docs/.md probe returned 404), first-party documentation of the llms.txt and its coverage, and independent or hands-on corroboration of agents using it.
